findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: acculynx_get_contact, companycam_list_comments, jobnimbus_list_contacts, hover_get_job, hover_get_inspection, leap_list_customers, sumoquote_get_signature_details · Private data: acculynx_get_estimates, acculynx_list_contact_types, acculynx_list_job_contacts, acculynx_get_contact, acculynx_create_contact, acculynx_add_contact_note, acculynx_create_job, jobnimbus_list_contacts, jobnimbus_get_contact, jobnimbus_list_jobs, jobnimbus_list_activities, jobnimbus_list_tasks, jobnimbus_list_estimates, jobnimbus_list_files, jobnimbus_create_contact, jobnimbus_create_job, jobnimbus_add_activity, jobnimbus_create_task, eagleview_get_report_json, eagleview_get_file_links · Public sink: acculynx_get_contact, companycam_add_project_comment, jobnimbus_list_contacts, jobnimbus_add_activity, hover_add_note, leap_list_customers, sumoquote_get_signature_details · Destructive: eagleview_place_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: acculynx_get_contact, companycam_list_comments, jobnimbus_list_contacts, hover_get_job, hover_get_inspection, leap_list_customers, sumoquote_get_signature_details · Private data: acculynx_get_estimates, acculynx_list_contact_types, acculynx_list_job_contacts, acculynx_get_contact, acculynx_create_contact, acculynx_add_contact_note, acculynx_create_job, jobnimbus_list_contacts, jobnimbus_get_contact, jobnimbus_list_jobs, jobnimbus_list_activities, jobnimbus_list_tasks, jobnimbus_list_estimates, jobnimbus_list_files, jobnimbus_create_contact, jobnimbus_create_job, jobnimbus_add_activity, jobnimbus_create_task, eagleview_get_report_json, eagleview_get_file_links · Public sink: acculynx_get_contact, companycam_add_project_comment, jobnimbus_list_contacts, jobnimbus_add_activity, hover_add_note, leap_list_customers, sumoquote_get_signature_details · Destructive: eagleview_place_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
